    The Turkish entry for the 1997 Eurovision Song Contest. Keep in mind that this is the version with the original lyrics and not the one with altered lyrics which was released after the contest due to some disputes.

    The original version of the song was available digitally from 2023 to 2025 and this is the AAC file I've purchased from iTunes last year. The cover image linked above is from Spotify and it actually belongs to a previous release of the 10-track album "Dinle" (Discogs link) that features the title track with the aforementioned altered lyrics. The 2023 release had a different cover which is included with the download but I like this cover a lot more so this is what's embedded to the AAC file. There is also another variant of this cover with the logo of the recording label which is included with the download as well.

    The folder structure of the download file is formatted according to Plex and there is also a background image and an artist avatar, sourced from the cover image linked above.
